      About this item

      • [Automatic Pop Up Tripod with Magnetic Auto-Close]-- Unlike traditional tripods that require multiple steps and manual leg adjustments, this tripod features a one-tap automatic pop-up system — Simply touch the ground with the bottom button, and the legs spring open instantly. When you're done, built-in magnetic plates help the legs snap closed effortlessly and securely, preventing accidental pinching. Whether you're capturing fast-paced moments, vlogging,live Streaming or setting up spontaneous selfies outdoors, this design ensures a quick, safe, and hassle-free experience every time.
      • [360° Rotating Handle & Adjustable Mobile Holder]--Lift the handle to unlock full 360° rotation for panoramic shooting; lower it to lock securely in place. The phone holder also supports 360° rotation and 180° forward-backward tilt, allowing seamless switching between portrait, landscape, or overhead angles — perfect for dynamic content creation from any perspective.
      • [Detachable & Rechargeable Bluetooth Remote]--Hands-Free Control Includes a built-in wireless remote with Type-C rechargeable battery. It detaches easily and pairs with iOS & Android devices, offering stable control up to 10m (33ft). Perfect for solo creators, group photos, or time-lapse videos.
      • [Universal 1/4" Screw for Multi-function Devices] Equipped with a standard 1/4-inch screw, this tripod goes beyond smartphones. Securely attach your action cameras, Mirrorless camera, or fill lights/ring lights. The 1/4" screws come with an auxiliary mounting knob to help you use them quickly. A truly multifunctional tool for photography and video shooting.
      • [Ultra-Long Reach for Wide-Angle Shots – Stable Build] Extends up to 71 inches (182cm) to capture wide-angle selfies, group photos, or travel landscapes with ease. Built with durable aluminum alloy telescopic rods and an upgraded umbrella structure tripod base for enhanced stability and long-lasting performance — even on uneven ground.
      • [Cold Shoe Interface]-The cold shoe mount allows you to attach accessories such as microphones, LED lights, monitors, or other compatible devices.
      • Noted:This is a large, heavy-duty shooting stick tripod that is ultra-long as well as ultra-stable, and versatile in its features!

        About this Item

        • [Automatic Pop Up Tripod with Magnetic Auto-Close]-- Unlike traditional tripods that require multiple steps and manual leg adjustments, this tripod features a one-tap automatic pop-up system — Simply touch the ground with the bottom button, and the legs spring open instantly. When you're done, built-in magnetic plates help the legs snap closed effortlessly and securely, preventing accidental pinching. Whether you're capturing fast-paced moments, vlogging,live Streaming or setting up spontaneous selfies outdoors, this design ensures a quick, safe, and hassle-free experience every time.
        • [360° Rotating Handle & Adjustable Mobile Holder]--Lift the handle to unlock full 360° rotation for panoramic shooting; lower it to lock securely in place. The phone holder also supports 360° rotation and 180° forward-backward tilt, allowing seamless switching between portrait, landscape, or overhead angles — perfect for dynamic content creation from any perspective.
        • [Detachable & Rechargeable Bluetooth Remote]--Hands-Free Control Includes a built-in wireless remote with Type-C rechargeable battery. It detaches easily and pairs with iOS & Android devices, offering stable control up to 10m (33ft). Perfect for solo creators, group photos, or time-lapse videos.
        • [Universal 1/4" Screw for Multi-function Devices] Equipped with a standard 1/4-inch screw, this tripod goes beyond smartphones. Securely attach your action cameras, Mirrorless camera, or fill lights/ring lights. The 1/4" screws come with an auxiliary mounting knob to help you use them quickly. A truly multifunctional tool for photography and video shooting.
        • [Ultra-Long Reach for Wide-Angle Shots – Stable Build] Extends up to 71 inches (182cm) to capture wide-angle selfies, group photos, or travel landscapes with ease. Built with durable aluminum alloy telescopic rods and an upgraded umbrella structure tripod base for enhanced stability and long-lasting performance — even on uneven ground.
        • [Cold Shoe Interface]-The cold shoe mount allows you to attach accessories such as microphones, LED lights, monitors, or other compatible devices.
        • Noted:This is a large, heavy-duty shooting stick tripod that is ultra-long as well as ultra-stable, and versatile in its features!

        Product description

        Experience next-level convenience and versatility with this 71" Automatic Pop-Up Tripod – the perfect companion for solo content creators, travelers, and mobile filmmakers. Say goodbye to complicated setups: simply press the base against the ground and watch the legs spring open instantly. The upgraded magnetic closure ensures a smooth and secure folding process when storing, preventing pinched fingers and saving precious time. Built with a durable yet lightweight aluminum alloy telescopic pole, this tripod extends up to 71 inches, providing ultra-wide shooting angles and perfect overhead or group shots. The enhanced umbrella-style tripod structure offers superior stability on various terrains, ensuring steady footage whether you’re vlogging in the city or shooting outdoors. Its 360° rotatable handle unlocks panoramic capture with a lift and locks firmly when lowered — giving you full control without the need for additional knobs. The phone holder rotates 360° and tilts 180°, enabling seamless switching between vertical, horizontal, or overhead shooting angles. Equipped with a detachable, rechargeable Bluetooth remote (compatible with both iOS and Android), you can snap photos or start video recordings from up to 10 meters (33 feet) away. Ideal for travel, live streaming, video calls, or social media content creation, this all-in-one solution blends power and portability in one compact, smartly engineered design. Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned creator, this auto-opening tripod makes filming smarter, faster, and more fun — wherever your story takes you.
